Do you want to work with us to help the shift towards a more sustainable world?

Is functional analysis your bread and butter? If so, you might be the Analytical Wizard we need to bring our ambitions to life. As a Functional Analyst, you actively contribute to innovative solutions that benefit millions of clients. 

You will help us to deliver the best suited, trusted, compliant and frictionless interaction across the customer journeys.  

At this moment, we are looking for several Functional Analysts in, amongst others, one of the following capacities:

• Collaborating in the implementation of customer journeys in our Web and mobile applications, across a variety banking products (Payments, Credits, Accounts, Investments, …) and in connection to the bank’s backend systems;
• Or translating business requirements for individual or corporate banking applications into feasible solutions;
• Or fostering interactions between employees and clients using the latest technologies: APIs,  distributed environment, cloud-based services…
We are open for candidates with all levels of experience (junior, medior, senior), but a strong motivation and interest in the matter are key!

Your job

As  functional analyst, you are part of a cross-functional, Agile team. Together, you design and develop qualitative applications to address the quickly evolving customer needs; an exciting and versatile challenge!

• You shape the functional requirements and propose multiple feasible solutions, evaluating the pros and cons of each
• You design the chosen solution in detail according to the architectural roadmap and share it with your squad 
• You provide further clarification and support to the developers
• You contribute to  the creation and execution of test cases
• You create and maintain clear documentation
• You provide support during the implementation and post-implementation phase

 Highlight your strengths

• You are result- and solution-driven
• You are quick to make connections, dare to challenge and strive to continuously improve
• You are a problem solver and can work independently
• You are the physical embodiment of the Scrum values: commitment, focus, openness and respect, and courage.
• You thrive in a team environment and are happy to share your knowledge and insights
• You have excellent communication skills: your messages are well-structured, both orally and in writing, and you adapt easily to your audience
• You are proficient in English;  in addition, knowledge of Dutch or French is definitely a plus
 You will delight us if you can show one of the following:

• Practical knowledge of APIs, Java-based distributed applications, Mainframe programs, SQL queries and data manipulation 
• Experience with software testing and testing tools
• Notions of data management and software life cycle management
• Working experience in an Agile environment

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Ready to help shape a more sustainable future with BNP Paribas Fortis?
 We’re looking for a Scrum Master who fosters trust, encourages open dialogue, and helps teams play to their strengths.
 If guiding delivery, aligning efforts, and empowering people is what drives you, let’s build something meaningful together.

• Several years of hands-on experience in a similar Agile delivery environment.

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas

- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
